chooseResponse.q: What do you think about the new library hours?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Have you seen the new library hours?
Librarian: Yes, they changed them to better accommodate students.
Student: I think they’re great for late-night studying.
Librarian: Absolutely! More students can now use the space when they need it.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the new library hours?
questions.explain: 新圖書館開放時間的目的在於讓更多學生受益。

questions.q: How does the student feel about the new hours?
questions.explain: 學生對新開放時間感到興奮。

announcement.transcript: Attention students! Starting next week, the campus gym will have new hours. It will open one hour earlier and close two hours later to better serve you. We hope this encourages more students to engage in fitness activities. Thank you for your attention!

questions.explain: 公告內容是在說健身房的開放時間延長。

questions.q: When will the new gym hours take effect?
questions.explain: 新的健身房開放時間將在下週開始。

talk.transcript: Today, I will discuss the concept of ecosystem services. Ecosystem services are the benefits that humans obtain from natural ecosystems. These include provisioning services like food and water, regulating services such as climate regulation and flood control, cultural services that provide recreational and spiritual benefits, and supporting services like nutrient cycling. Understanding these services is crucial for sustainable development because they are essential for our well-being and the health of our planet. Conservation efforts often focus on preserving these services to ensure that they continue to support both nature and humanity.

questions.explain: 生態系統服務是指人類從自然生態系統中獲得的好處。

questions.q: What is an example of a provisioning service?
questions.explain: 提供服務的範例是食物生產。
生態系統服務對可持續發展至關重要。

questions.q: What do conservation efforts focus on?
questions.explain: 保護工作重點是保護生態系統服務。
